title: 最小的恐龙有多小
subtitle: 比一只鸽子还轻
character: wearing a pale moss green t-shirt, dove grey shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, soft pastel drawing with powdery grain and gently blended edges, pale moss green, dove grey and apricot

pages.zh:
这个柜子特别小。
里面那只恐龙，
从头到尾
还没有我的胳膊长。
爸爸说它早就长大了。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy leaning close to a small glass case holding a tiny dinosaur skeleton, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, curious.

pages.zh:
它到底有多大呢？
跟一只鸽子差不多。
两个并排站着，
鸽子看着还要
胖出一圈来。

它又有多重呢？
只有几十克，
和一只麻雀一样。
放在秤上，
还没有一个鸡蛋沉。

它就住在树上。
爪子细细的，
正好勾住小树枝。
风一吹过来，
它跟着枝子一起晃。
pages.scene: One small feathered dinosaur perched on a thin tree branch with its claws gripping the branch, seen from the side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它的脑袋很小，
比一颗核桃大不了多少。
嘴里那些牙
细得像针尖，
一根一根排得很密。

它专吃小虫子。
嘴往前一啄，
把爬过去的甲虫
一口叼起来，
仰着脖子吞下去。
pages.scene: One small feathered dinosaur bending down to catch a beetle on the ground, seen from the side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
最大的恐龙
有三十米那么长。
这一只有多长呢？
站起来连半米都不到，
差了六十多倍。

它身上长着羽毛。
天一冷下来，
羽毛就蓬起来，
把自己裹成
圆圆的一个小绒球。
pages.scene: One small feathered dinosaur asleep with its head tucked under one wing and its feathers fluffed up, seen from the side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它的骨头是空心的。
里面有细细的格子，
又轻又结实。
捧在手里，
轻得像一团棉花。
pages.scene: One thin dinosaur leg bone cut open on a cream background showing the hollow space and the fine struts inside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它下的蛋
比鹌鹑蛋还小。
一窝好几个，
挨着围成一圈，
刚好放满一只手心。

它的化石压扁了，
嵌在一块石板里。
骨头细得像线，
连羽毛的印子
也印在旁边。
pages.scene: One flat slab of stone on a cream background with the fine skeleton of a small dinosaur pressed into it and faint feather marks all around it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我把两只手
合成一个小窝。
最小的恐龙，
一只手就能捧住。
它也是恐龙呀。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy holding both hands cupped together in front of him as if holding something very small, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, smiling.
